sloka: उपभुक्तम् यथा वासः स्रजो वा मृदिता यथा ।एवम् राज्यात् परिभ्रष्टः समर्थो अपि निरर्थकः ॥३-३३-१९॥
transliteration: upabhuktam yathā vāsaḥ srajo vā mṛditā yathā ।evam rājyāt paribhraṣṭaḥ samartho api nirarthakaḥ ॥3-33-19॥

translations.english: Like a piece of cloth that is worn and discarded, like garlands put on and crushed, a king dislodged from the kingdom is worthless even if he is capable.
